measures.title: Lebanon School District (SAU #88) Property Tax Growth Limit
measures.summary: A statutory question required by HB 1300 (Chapter 324, 2026) asking whether the City of Lebanon should limit property tax growth for the Lebanon School District (SAU #88) under RSA 32:5-i. If adopted for a two-year period, the local property tax levy could not grow beyond the prior year's amount adjusted for inflation and new construction, SAU central office spending could not exceed 6 percent of total school district appropriations, and bonded capital costs would be excluded from both limits. Per the ballot text, the caps apply only to SAU central office administrative operations, may be overridden as provided in RSA 32:5-i, and adoption requires a three-fifths (3/5) majority.
measures.yesMeans: The listed property tax growth and SAU central office spending limits are adopted for the Lebanon School District for a two-year period.
